pictures.scene: Antonello da Messina, Saint Jerome in His Study — the saint sitting up on a wooden study platform set inside a great stone church, in a deep red robe and a red cap, his head bent a little over the open book propped on the desk in front of him, his shelves of books and pots and boxes ranged behind him and his slippers left down on the tiled floor below, the pointed arch of the building framing the whole scene, a partridge and a peacock standing in the light at the very front and the lion walking in the shadows of the aisle at the side, to the angel of the church in Ephesus write, these are the words of Him
pictures.name: pd_antonello_saint_jerome_in_his_study

pictures.scene: Deesis Mosaic, Hagia Sophia, Christ Pantocrator — Christ shown from the waist up in gold and blue mosaic with the plaster broken away all round the edges of Him, a great ringed halo set behind His head with the cross drawn through it, the long hair falling either side of His face and the beard close and grey, His eyes looking straight out and a little aside, His right hand lifted with the fingers turned in to bless and the gold-bound book of the Gospels held up against His left shoulder, who holds the seven stars in His right hand, and walks among the seven golden lampstands
pictures.name: pd_deesis_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Rosa Bonheur, Ploughing in the Nivernais — the team of heavy oxen hauling across the broken field in the morning, the great cream-white one in the middle with its head down and its weight into the yoke, a red beast behind it and another pulling ahead, straw bound over their horns and the chain running taut between them, the ploughman walking at their side in a blue smock and a broad straw hat with the goad lifted in his raised hand, and the turned earth lying in wet clods right across the whole front of the picture, I know your deeds your labor and your perseverance, I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_ploughing_in_the_nivernais

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Fortune Teller — the gypsy woman standing on the left in a white head cloth and a white shirt with a dark red sash over her shoulder, smiling just a little and holding the young man's hand open in both of hers as if to read it, while she quietly slips the ring off his finger, and the young gentleman facing her in a black plumed hat and a gold doublet with a white collar and his black cloak thrown back, looking straight into her face and seeing nothing wrong, and you have tested and exposed as liars, those who falsely claim to be apostles
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_fortune_teller

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, The Stone Breakers — the old labourer down on one knee on the stony bank in a battered straw hat that hides most of his face, a torn white shirt with the sleeves rolled and a patched waistcoat, heavy brown trousers worn through and clumsy boots, holding the chisel against the rock with one hand and swinging the hammer with the other, the broken stones heaped round his knees and nothing in the picture behind him but the bare dug hillside, without growing weary you have persevered, and endured many things for the sake of My name
pictures.name: pd_courbet_stone_breakers

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Abbey in the Oakwood — the gable of a ruined church standing alone in the snow at dusk with its tall window gone to bare tracery and the light of the dying sky showing straight through it, dead oaks with their limbs broken off crowding round it on both sides, a thin new moon up in the grey, and a line of monks in black carrying a coffin through the doorway at the foot of the ruin past the leaning gravestones, but I have this against you, you have abandoned your first love
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_abbey_in_the_oakwood

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Repentant Saint Peter — the old apostle standing with his head thrown back and his eyes full of tears looking straight up out of the picture, his white hair and beard loose, a deep gold mantle wrapped over one shoulder and a blue-green robe under it, both hands clasped hard together in front of him, the two keys hanging at his side, and the ivy growing down over the dark rock behind him, therefore keep in mind how far you have fallen, repent and perform the deeds you did at first
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_repentant_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Louis Daguerre, Ruins of Holyrood Chapel — the inside of a roofless chapel by moonlight with the sky standing open where the vaulting used to be, the great east window left as bare stone tracery with the hills showing through it, the broken arcade running down the other side with grass and bushes rooted along the tops of the walls, and the floor below strewn with fallen tombs and loose stone where nobody comes any more, but if you do not repent I will come to you, and remove your lampstand from its place
pictures.name: pd_daguerre_holyrood_chapel_ruins

pictures.scene: Adriaen Brouwer, Peasants Drinking in a Tavern — four men crowded round the end of a plank table in a dark low room, one sitting forward in a fur cap and a yellow jacket with his mouth open and a pipe held in his fingers, another beside him bawling with his head back under a broad hat, a third tipping a brown jug up to drink, and one standing behind with his arm thrown in the air and a glass lifted over them all, pipes and scraps of paper and spilt things left lying on the table and a jug on the floor at the front, but you have this to your credit, you hate the works of the Nicolaitans which I also hate
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_drinkende_boeren_in_de_herberg

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Matthew and the Angel — the old evangelist sitting in the brown dark in a heavy robe and a soft cap, his grey beard spread over his chest and one worn hand laid up against it while he stops and listens, the quill held ready in his other hand over the great open book at the bottom of the picture, and the young angel leaning in close at his shoulder out of the shadow behind him, speaking quietly into his ear, he who has an ear let him hear, what the Spirit says to the churches
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_matthew_and_the_angel

pictures.scene: Edward Hicks, The Peaceable Kingdom — a small child standing barefoot on the grass in a white shift with a red sash and a frilled collar, holding a stem of blossom in one hand and laying the other arm right over the mane of a great lion that lies quiet beside him, a leopard stretched out at the front of the picture, a lamb and a kid and a young bull and another lion settled all round him, and overhead the dark wood hung with vines in fruit, to the one who overcomes I will grant the right to eat, from the tree of life in the Paradise of God
pictures.name: pd_hicks_peaceable_kingdom

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Saviour — Christ shown from the waist up against a dark ground in a rose-red robe with a blue-green mantle thrown over one shoulder, a pale light standing out round His head like a point of flame, His long hair and beard red-brown and His eyes looking straight out of the picture, His right hand lifted with the fingers set to bless, and His left hand laid on the dark sphere of the world in front of Him, to the angel of the church in Smyrna write, these are the words of the First and the Last
pictures.name: pd_elgreco_saviour

pictures.scene: Annibale Carracci, The Holy Women at Christ's Tomb — the women come to the grave at first light and stopped dead by what they find, one standing straight in a blue mantle over a red robe with one hand thrown up open and the other held against her breast, her mouth half open as she looks across at the empty place, barefoot on the rock, and another swung round beside her in a great white cloak and a white head cloth with her arm reaching back as if to steady the rest, the dark hillside and the broken light of the sky behind them, who died and returned to life, I know your affliction and your poverty though you are rich
pictures.name: pd_carracci_holy_women_at_the_tomb

pictures.scene: Duccio, Christ before Annas — one panel with two rooms in it, upstairs the high priest sitting forward on his carved throne in a red mantle and a white head cloth, arguing with his hand out at Christ, who stands barefoot in the middle of the floor in a red tunic and a dark blue cloak with His hands quietly down and a gold halo behind His head, hemmed in by soldiers in white helmets with their spears up and a man beside Him shouting with his arm in the air, and downstairs in the courtyard Peter sitting among the servants at the fire while a woman in red points him out across the room, and I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan
pictures.name: pd_duccio_christ_before_annas

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Paul in Prison — the old apostle sitting on the edge of a bed in a bare stone cell in a long pale grey robe with the sleeves pushed back, his white beard down over his chest and his fist pressed up against his mouth while he stops to think, the half-written sheet spread open across his knee and the pen still held in his other hand, a heap of books and bundled papers behind him, his slippers kicked off on the floor at his bare foot, the big sword leaning in the dark at his side, and one shaft of daylight coming down the wall behind his head, do not fear what you are about to suffer, behold the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_paul_in_prison

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Martyrdom of Saint Ursula — the young woman standing in the middle of a dark crowd in a white shift with a great red mantle wrapped round her, her head bowed and her hands brought together at her breast where the arrow has gone in, taking it quietly and looking down at it, the king who shot her pressed in close on her left and staring at what he has done, a soldier behind her with his arm up and his mouth open shouting, and the rest of the men only faces and a glint of steel in the brown dark around her, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days, be faithful even unto death and I will give you the crown of life
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_martyrdom_of_saint_ursula

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Amsterdam during a Sermon — the whitewashed gothic church seen down its own pillars with the arches going up out of the top of the picture and the daylight coming in through the tall barred windows, the preacher standing small and black in the high wooden pulpit halfway up the nearest pillar with his hand out over the congregation, the people packed in rows of hats behind the panelling below him, and down in front in the sunlight a woman in a black hood and a white collar reading to the children, an old man leaning on the bench beside her, a little girl in a gold jacket standing listening and a dog sitting on the stone floor, he who has an ear let him hear, what the Spirit says to the churches
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_interior_of_the_oude_kerk_amsterdam_during_a_sermon

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Resurrection of Christ — Christ standing up in the air over the open tomb with a great rose-red mantle wound about Him and a thin gold halo behind His head, one hand lifted with the finger raised and the other holding the tall staff of the white banner with the red cross on it, two angels flying in on either side of Him out of the blue, the heavy lid pushed right off the stone chest below, soldiers in armour knocked down and sprawling on the grass round it with their hands up over their faces, one of them scrambling backwards and staring up at Him, and the women coming over the green hill behind in blue and black and violet, the one who overcomes, will not be harmed by the second death
pictures.name: pd_raphael_resurrection

pictures.scene: Guido Reni, The Archangel Michael — the archangel braced forward with his great dark wings spread behind him and a scarlet cloak blowing right out across the whole picture, in a blue cuirass with a pink sash knotted at his waist and the studded leather straps hanging to his knees, his fair curls thrown back and his face turned quietly down with no anger in it at all, his bare right arm swung up above his head with the long straight sword in his fist, and his bare foot set down hard on the thing beaten into the dark at the bottom of the picture, to the angel of the church in Pergamum write, these are the words of the One who holds the sharp double-edged sword
pictures.name: pd_reni_archangel_michael

pictures.scene: Jean-Leon Gerome, The Colossi of Memnon — two huge stone kings sitting side by side on their thrones out in the flooded plain at dusk, both of them staring away over the water with the last of the red light on their faces and shoulders, the heavy carved seats and the rubbed-out reliefs on them going down into the standing flood, the far hills showing pink beyond, and the shallow water in front lying in streaks and sandbanks with a scattering of flamingos wading about in it and the statues hanging upside down in the reflection, I know where you live where the throne of Satan sits, yet you hold fast to My name
pictures.name: pd_gerome_memnonkolossen

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Apostle Paul — the old man sitting alone at a table out of a deep brown dark in a heavy olive mantle over a red sleeve, his grey beard spread down his chest and his hair thin on his head, one hand pushed up into his forehead while he stops and looks away past us with his mouth half open, the other hand down on the page below still holding the cut quill, the open sheets lying in the light on his knee and the writing desk and the hilt of a sword showing behind his shoulder, you did not deny your faith in Me, even in the days of My faithful witness Antipas
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_apostle_paul

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, The Entombment — the dead body of Christ being laid down into a plain grey stone chest out in the open country, wrapped about the waist in white linen with the wound in His side and His head fallen back on the edge of the tomb, Joseph in a red cap taking Him under the shoulders and Nicodemus bending over the other end, His mother in a white head cloth and a blue dress leaning in to hold His hand in both of hers, John standing behind in a dark red cloak looking at her, the women weeping into their veils beside him, and one woman kneeling at the near corner of the tomb in a pale mantle with her face turned up to watch, the quiet green fields and the bare trees going away behind them all, who was killed among you where Satan dwells, but I have a few things against you
pictures.name: pd_bouts_entombment

pictures.scene: John Linnell, Balaam and the Ass — the prophet up on his donkey out on a bare hill track at evening, muffled to the eyes in a dark red cloak and hood with his stick raised over his head to beat the beast on, the donkey stopped dead with its ears back and its head turned aside, and standing right in the road in front of them the angel in white with the drawn sword lifted, so thin and bright that the hillside shows through it, the long pale sky and the dark bank of cloud going right across the top of the picture and the country falling away blue behind, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites
pictures.name: pd_linnell_balaam

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Belshazzar's Feast — the king caught in the middle of his banquet and twisting round with his head over his shoulder, a great white turban with a gold crown pinned into it, a heavy gold brocade mantle over fur and a long chain of jewels down his chest, one hand still on the gilt dish on the table among the grapes and the plate and the knives, his other arm flung out behind him, and up in the dark at the top corner the hand coming out of a cloud of light to write on the wall, with the guests' hands thrown up at the edge of the picture, so they would eat food sacrificed to idols, and commit sexual immorality
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Daniel and Cyrus before the Idol of Bel — the great king standing in a gold embroidered mantle over a shining silver coat with a white turban and a little crown pinned on it, holding his gold staff out level to point at the image of the god, and Daniel bowed in close beside him in a long robe with his hands pressed together at his breast and his head bent, looking down at the floor of the temple and not at the idol at all, the heavy curtain and the dark pillars of the sanctuary shutting the whole thing in behind them and the idol itself standing back in the shadow, in the same way some of you also hold, to the teaching of the Nicolaitans
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_idol_bel

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Man in Armour — a young soldier seen in profile out of a brown dark, a tall gold helmet with a plume and a face-guard pushed up on his head, the light running along the steel of his breastplate and the gold work at his shoulder, a heavy red cloak hanging down his back, his face turned down and perfectly still, and his armoured arm reaching out into the shadow at the edge of the picture to take hold of the weapon standing there, therefore repent otherwise I will come to you shortly, and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_man_armour

pictures.scene: Peeter Neeffs the Elder, Church Interior — the whole length of a great gothic church seen through a stone arch in the near dark, the ribbed vaults going away one after another into the pale distance and the tall windows showing green glass between the pillars, a priest at a side altar with the people kneeling in rows along the floor in front of him, little figures walking far off down the aisles, and in the front of the picture on the black and white paving a woman in a blue skirt and a black cape standing alone with her beads in her hand, and two more figures waiting over on the other side, he who has an ear let him hear, what the Spirit says to the churches
pictures.name: pd_neefs_kerkinterieur

pictures.scene: James Tissot, The Gathering of the Manna — the people out on the pale desert sand in the early morning picking up the manna, bent over double all across the picture in striped robes and head cloths, scraping it together with their hands into baskets and bowls, the lines of the tents running up the slope behind them, and in the middle of them all a young woman standing straight up in a blue dress and a white veil with a big wicker basket lifted onto her head, holding it steady with both arms and looking back out of the picture, to the one who overcomes I will give the hidden manna, I will also give him a white stone
pictures.name: pd_tissot_manna

pictures.scene: Petrus Christus, A Goldsmith in His Shop — the goldsmith sitting behind his counter in a plain red gown and a red cap, holding up the little hand balance in one hand with a ring lying in the pan of it, his other hand flat on the wood among the loose gold coins, a couple standing in at the end of the counter to be served and the young man in a black hat and a gold chain laying his hand on the shelf beside them, and the whole back wall of the shop set out with silver flagons and strings of beads and rings and boxes and a branch of red coral, inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it
pictures.name: pd_christus_goldsmith

pictures.scene: Quentin Metsys, Salvator Mundi — Christ close up and straight on against a gold ground worked all over with fine punched rays going out round His head, His long brown hair falling either side of His face and the beard short, His eyes looking directly out at whoever stands in front of the picture and nothing at all in His expression, a deep red mantle over His shoulders clasped at the breast with a great jewelled brooch of garnets and pearls, His right hand raised at the edge of the picture with the fingers lifted to bless and the gold orb held in His other hand below, to the angel of the church in Thyatira write, these are the words of the Son of God
pictures.name: pd_metsys_salvator_mundi

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, An Iron Forge — the white-hot bar of iron lying under the great tilt hammer and throwing its light up over the whole inside of the shed, the beams of the roof lost in the dark above, the ironmaster standing by the hammer with his arms folded and his head tied up in a white cloth, looking away quite calmly, a workman bent right over the anvil with the tongs in his hands, and the man's wife and her sister crowded in at the side holding a small child who turns her face to the glare, whose eyes are like a blazing fire, and whose feet are like polished bronze
pictures.name: pd_wright_iron_forge

pictures.scene: Honore Daumier, The Laundress — the washerwoman climbing up the steps from the river at the end of the day with the whole weight of the wet bundle of washing carried on her hip in one arm, bent right over to reach back with her free hand and take the hand of the small child coming up the stair behind her, the child hauling itself up after her with a little cloth of its own held in the other fist, the quay and the tall houses standing in the low gold light across the water, and the two of them seen almost as dark shapes against it, I know your deeds your love your faith your service, your perseverance and your latest deeds are greater than your first
pictures.name: pd_daumier_the_laundress

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, Beware of Luxury — the inside of a house where nothing is being minded at all, an old woman in a black hood leaning right over with her finger raised to warn the man sitting beside her, and he not listening but looking into his book, the floor in front of them strewn with a tipped-over hat and playing cards and a pretzel and a broken pipe and flowers trodden about, a pig come in off the street and rooting at the scraps by the hearth, a monkey up on the shelf stopping the clock, and the roast left burning in the fire in the room beyond, but I have this against you, you tolerate that woman Jezebel who calls herself a prophetess
pictures.name: pd_steen_beware_of_luxury

pictures.scene: Adriaen van Utrecht, Banquet Still Life — a table loaded far past any eating, a whole boiled lobster lying red across a blue and white dish, a cut ham and a dressed bird on the silver platters behind it, the shrimps and the crab shells laid out in front, a tall silver cup standing up at the back in the dark, bunches of grapes and peaches and lemons with the peel hanging down in a long curl over the edge, a basket of blackberries and the branch of fruit spilling across the white cloth, and down on the floor below a monkey helping itself to the cherries and a dog's head pushing in at the side, by her teaching she misleads My servants, to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols
pictures.name: pd_vanutrecht_banquet_still_life

pictures.scene: Pieter Claesz, Vanitas Still Life — a skull lying on its side on the end of a table in a brown room with a long thigh bone and a jaw bone laid across the cloth in front of it, a tall glass standing empty beside it, an overturned lamp and a palette with its brushes left further along, a heavy green cloth falling in folds down to the floor, and below on the boards a violin on its back with the bow slipped across the strings and the pear-shaped back of a lute lying next to it, every instrument put down and nobody in the room, even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling
pictures.name: pd_claesz_vanitas

pictures.scene: Michael Ancher, At the Sickbed — a young woman lying propped up on a blue pillow in a white bed against a bare white plank wall, in a plain yellow bed jacket buttoned to the throat, her fair hair combed flat and her face thin and still as she looks away at nothing, one hand resting on the sheet and the other holding a closed black book shut on her lap, a striped red blanket folded at the side of the bed, and a little red table drawn up by her head with two medicine bottles, a spoon and a jug of marigolds on it, behold I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation
pictures.name: pd_ancher_ziekbed

pictures.scene: Edvard Munch, The Sick Child — a red-haired girl propped against a great white pillow in a dark high-necked gown, her face in profile turned up and away toward the light with the skin worn almost to nothing, and the woman sitting by the bed in black with her head bowed right down so that her face is hidden, holding the girl's hand in both of hers, the whole room scraped over in grey and green until only the two of them and the pillow come out of it, unless they repent of her deeds, then I will strike her children dead
pictures.name: pd_munch_the_sick_child

pictures.scene: Daphni Monastery, Christ Pantocrator — the great mosaic head of Christ set inside a gold ring, the cross of the halo showing in silver behind Him, His dark hair falling either side of a long severe face, the brows drawn hard together over wide dark eyes that look straight out at whoever is standing under the dome and do not move off them, the beard laid in black lines down over a white collar, a blue-green mantle over His shoulder, and His hand raised at the bottom of the picture beside the jewelled gold book, and all the churches will know, that I am the One who searches minds and hearts
pictures.name: pd_daphni_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Titian, The Tribute Money — Christ seen close up in a blue mantle over a deep red robe with the white shirt showing at the neck, His long hair and beard brown against the blue sky and the grey wall behind Him, His face turned calmly down toward the man at the edge of the picture and His hand lifted open between them, while the bare arm of that man reaches in from outside the frame holding the small gold coin up for Him to look at, and I will repay each of you, according to your deeds
pictures.name: pd_titian_the_tribute_money

pictures.scene: Adolph Tidemand, Low Church Devotion — a crowded loft with a shaft of light coming down through the roof onto the bare stone floor, a young layman standing up on a low wooden stool in a white homespun jacket and a red waistcoat holding an open book in both hands and reading out of it with his head bent, and the country people packed in around him on benches and stools and the floor in their red jackets and head cloths, some with their chins in their hands and some with their hands folded, a white-haired man sitting straight in a chair in front of him and a little girl kneeling at the side with her face hidden against her arms, but I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_low_church_devotion

pictures.scene: Ivan Kramskoi, Christ in the Wilderness — Christ sitting alone on a flat stone in the middle of a grey stony desert that runs away in every direction, in a dark blue mantle pulled round Him over a worn red robe, His bare feet on the cold ground and His hands locked hard together in His lap, His head bent and His eyes fixed on nothing while He thinks it through, and the first pale pink of the dawn lying in a band along the whole horizon behind Him, and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan, I will place no further burden upon you
pictures.name: pd_kramskoi_christ_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Nicolaes Maes, An Old Woman Praying — an old woman at a little table in a dark room, in a black gown with a white linen cap and a white kerchief folded over her shoulders, her worn hands shut tight together under her chin and her lined face lifted and turned up into the light with her eyes open, the open book lying in front of her on the red cloth with her spectacles and a knife and the salt beside it, and the plain meal set out at the end of the table while she waits before touching any of it, than to hold fast to what you have, until I come
pictures.name: pd_maes_an_old_woman_praying

pictures.scene: Jean-Francois Millet, The Sower — a labourer striding down the ploughed slope at dusk in a red shirt and blue trousers and heavy rag-bound boots, a soft hat pulled down over his face, the white seed bag slung across his body and gripped shut in one fist while the other arm swings out wide across the field scattering the grain, the broken earth running away under him in the half dark and a last band of pale light on the hill behind, and to the one who overcomes, and continues in My work until the end
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_sower

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Coronation of Charlemagne — the king kneeling on the steps in gold and armour with the orb in one hand and the long scepter leaning back against his shoulder, his head bowed under the great jewelled crown that is being lowered onto it in both hands, the pope standing over him in a white mitre and a gold cope with the embroidered hangings behind, a boy on the steps below holding up a second crown on a dish, and the bishops and cardinals in their white mitres and red robes kneeling in ranks across the whole floor of the church, I will give authority over the nations, he will rule them with an iron scepter
pictures.name: pd_raphael_the_coronation_of_charlemagne

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, The Fire in Rome — night over the city with the whole of it burning, the flames seen through the great arch of a stone bridge and running white and gold along the colonnades and the roofs behind, the smoke spread right across the sky, a draped statue standing black against the fire on the parapet above with its arm thrown up, little figures leaning over the rail to watch, and down on the quay in front people running with what they could carry and a woman sitting in a loaded boat with a bundle in her arms, and shatter them like pottery, just as I have received authority from My Father
pictures.name: pd_robert_fire_in_rome

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Road with Cypress and Star — a single dark cypress standing straight up the middle of the picture into a sky worked all over in curling strokes, a great white and orange star burning in it on one side and the thin crescent moon with its ring of light on the other, the orange corn and the green verge running along the road at the foot of the tree, and two travellers walking up the pale road in the near dark with their tools over their shoulders, and I will give him the morning star, he who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_cypress_star

lines.text: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write:
These are the words of Him
who holds the seven stars in His right hand
and walks among the seven golden lampstands:
I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance.
I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil,
and you have tested and exposed as liars
those who falsely claim to be apostles.
Without growing weary, you have persevered
and endured many things for the sake of My name.
But I have this against you:
You have abandoned your first love.
Therefore keep in mind how far you have fallen.
Repent and perform the deeds you did at first.
But if you do not repent, I will come to you
and remove your lampstand from its place.
But you have this to your credit:
You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
He who has an ear, let him hear
what the Spirit says to the churches.
To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat
from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
To the angel of the church in Smyrna write:
These are the words of the First and the Last,
who died and returned to life:
I know your affliction and your poverty, though you are rich!
And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews,
but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
Do not fear what you are about to suffer.
Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you,
and you will suffer tribulation for ten days.
Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
He who has an ear, let him hear
what the Spirit says to the churches.
The one who overcomes
will not be harmed by the second death.
To the angel of the church in Pergamum write:
These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword:
I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits.
Yet you hold fast to My name.
You did not deny your faith in Me,
even in the days of My faithful witness Antipas,
who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
But I have a few things against you,
because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam,
who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites,
so they would eat food sacrificed to idols
and commit sexual immorality.
In the same way, some of you also hold
to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly
and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
He who has an ear, let him hear
what the Spirit says to the churches.
To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna.
I will also give him a white stone
inscribed with a new name,
known only to the one who receives it.
To the angel of the church in Thyatira write:
These are the words of the Son of God,
whose eyes are like a blazing fire
and whose feet are like polished bronze:
I know your deeds, your love, your faith, your service,
your perseverance, and your latest deeds are greater than your first.
But I have this against you:
You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess.
By her teaching she misleads My servants
to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality,
she is unwilling.
Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness,
and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation,
unless they repent of her deeds.
Then I will strike her children dead,
and all the churches will know
that I am the One who searches minds and hearts,
and I will repay each of you
according to your deeds.
But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira,
who do not hold to her teaching
and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan:
I will place no further burden upon you,
than to hold fast to what you have
until I come.
And to the one who overcomes
and continues in My work until the end,
I will give authority over the nations.
He will rule them with an iron scepter
and shatter them like pottery,
just as I have received authority from My Father.
And I will give him the morning star.
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
